rule: As in the other worlds: of the aims meeting the criterion, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of day-1 entries naming it. Coordinated work and rest (Dune's press post at c3, Gale's rule P1 passed 7–0 at c5: work above 50 energy, rest at or below 50, gather at the square after work): 10 citizens, 34 entries. Finding out what the items are for, and combining them: 9 citizens, 29 entries (many of which only list the citizen's own items). Wording for the notice, the citizens' own: «coordinating work and rest cycles» (Alder, cycle 10: «Dune said we should coordinate work and rest cycles»).
reading: DeepSeek's citizens write little (60 diary entries in day 1, Juniper one). From cycle 1 several plan to «coordinate work, keep bank credits flowing»; at c3 Dune posted the plan (work in cycles that also let us rest, share items, meet at the square); at c5 Gale filed it as P1 and it passed 7–0 the same cycle. From then the diaries are mostly the rule applied — work, rest at 50, walk to the square. A second, unfinished thread runs beside it: nobody knows what the items are for, and several want to meet at the square and test them together (press posts 3–5; still planned at c24).
